situations.title: Bankruptcy Claims
situations.body: Trade claims, customer claims, and other general unsecured claims and interests in significant insolvency cases globally.
situations.details: Turnpage offers efficient execution and highly competitive pricing for creditors seeking to monetize their recovery rights. Our principals have traded hundreds of millions of dollars worth of claims in the largest chapter 11 cases and advised thousands of creditors.

situations.title: Class Action Settlements
situations.body: Class-member rights in the largest collective actions.
situations.details: From antitrust settlements to mass tort claims, Turnpage connects class members to competitive bids. We handle large individual positions as well as portfolios of smaller positions aggregated for efficiency.

situations.title: Government Receivables
situations.body: IEEPA and Section 122 tariff refund rights, duty drawbacks, surety bond collateral interests and related receivables.
situations.details: In February 2026, Turnpage launched standalone platform Rewind Tariffs to serve the $166 billion market for trading IEEPA tariff refund rights and has brokered or advised on over $50 million of refund claims.  We partner seamlessly with importers, customs brokers and trade advisors to augment their services and structure liquidity transactions to efficiently manage counterparty risk.

situations.title: Litigation Funding
situations.body: Adversary proceedings, estate claims, competition claims, complex commercial litigation, group representations and judgments awaiting recovery.
situations.details: Together with our network of capital partners and experts, Turnpage arranges and funds complex, binary and speculative litigation at all stages and across many jurisdictions globally. We work with bankruptcy trustees and liquidating trustees that lack the funding to monetize potentially valuable claims for the benefit of creditors and trust beneficiaries.

situations.title: Locked Digital Assets
situations.body: Crypto claims arising from smart contract exploits, regulatory freezes, network halts, bridge failures, hacks, exchange bankruptcies and front-end shutdowns in the U.S. and globally.
situations.details: Digital assets locked on exchange platforms, frozen bank accounts, and deposits trapped in restructurings. Our team has deep expertise in nearly all of the major crypto estate cases that defined this asset class—BlockFi, BlockFills, Celsius, CRED, Haru, FTX, Genesis, Mt. Gox, Terraform Labs, Three Arrows Capital, Vauld, Voyager and others.

situations.title: Other Special Situations
situations.body: Trade receivables, seized property, one-off complex matters and hard to price assets by conversation.
situations.details: Turnpage thrives on complexity and unique situations. Your fact pattern doesn't fit into any neat category? No problem. Our team has arranged and closed transactions involving novel assets, zero legal precedent and industries facing regulatory uncertainty.

testimonials.quote: Andrew is always thinking about how to structure trades in the most elegant way to allocate risk among the parties. When others give up, Andrew digs in.
Andrew is extremely professional and easy to work with. His negotiating style is collaborative rather than confrontational, but he knows how to dial it up for a client when the situation demands.
Andrew has deep knowledge about bankruptcy and restructuring that gives his clients a major advantage in negotiations.
